name: findaffiliates
description: Research affiliate programs, compare offers, use affiliate calculators, plan a company program, and navigate existing FindAffiliates account features through the website.

interface.longDescription: Find affiliate programs for your niche and audience, compare published offers, estimate commissions and content ROI, and use company program pricing and launch tools. Uses ChatGPT's available browser or web retrieval to work with FindAffiliates pages. Public research needs no FindAffiliates account; account features require your own signed-in session and existing access. Results reflect the pages available to your account and may contain unverified or missing terms. Does not purchase subscriptions, submit paid listings, or enroll you in third-party programs. Website interaction requires browsing capabilities and the applicable website permissions.
defaultPrompt: Find affiliate programs that fit my newsletter's niche and audience, with sources and clear unknowns.
Compare two affiliate programs and estimate earnings using assumptions I provide.
Help me choose an affiliate commission and check my company's launch readiness.
